//: Holds the root-level JS config so it belongs to a real TypeScript project. Each workspace has its own tsconfig and editors pick the nearest one per file; this file also means an editor opened at the repo root is never left inferring a project, which is what left @agapay/shared unresolved before packages/shared/dist had been built.
//references: Deliberately omitted. Project references need composite: true, and composite forbids noEmit, so wiring them would collapse the check/build tsconfig split that keeps test files out of dist. Nothing here runs `tsc -b`.
